question_text: A government employee posts a critical comment on social media about her agency's policies. Her supervisor reprimands her, citing a policy that prohibits employees from making negative statements about the agency. Under Article III of the 1987 Constitution, which of the following is the most relevant protection for the employee?

options.text: The right to freedom of speech and expression.
The right to peaceably assemble and petition the government.
The right to form associations and labor unions.
The right to access public records and documents.
